description.value: Delta Nature Reserve is a Metro Vancouver regional park that forms part of the Burns Bog Ecological Conservancy Area, one of the largest undeveloped urban landmasses in North America. Originally operated by the City of Delta, it was transferred to Metro Vancouver in November 2020. The reserve offers nature trails through bog and wetland habitat, making it a peaceful stop for touring cyclists passing through the flat farmland south of the Fraser River.
